eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 3:11 PM on AUG 3, 2026 Effective until 1:11 AM AUG 4, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A SAFE Alert has been issued for Phoenix Police Department. This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. The Phoenix Police Department is looking for a white male, David Clay, approximately 6 feet 0 inches tall and weighing 200 pounds, with brown hair and brown eyes. He was last seen wearing a red shirt, black shorts, black shoes, a blue hat, wearing a towel around his neck and carrying several bags. Mr. Clay was last observed on foot on August 1, 2026, at approximately 2300 hours in the area of North 19thAvenue and West Greenway Road in the city of Phoenix, Maricopa County. He is reported to have a medical condition that may cause confusion, raising concern for his safety and well-being. If you have contact with this SAFE Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
